title: Imagine2Act: Leveraging Object-Action Motion Consistency from Imagined Goals for Robotic Manipulation
title_zh: Imagine2Act：利用想象目标中的物体-动作运动一致性进行机器人操作
abstract: Relational object rearrangement (ROR) tasks (e.g. insert flower to vase ) require a robot to manipulate objects with precise semantic and geometric reasoning. Existing approaches either rely on pre-collected demonstrations that struggle to capture complex geometric constraints or generate goal-state observations to capture semantic and geometric knowledge, but fail to explicitly couple object transformation with action prediction, resulting in errors due to generative noise. To address these limitations, we propose Imagine2Act, a 3D imitation-learning framework that incorporates semantic and geometric constraints of objects into policy learning to tackle high-precision manipulation tasks. We first generate imagined goal images conditioned on language instructions and reconstruct corresponding 3D point clouds to provide robust semantic and geometric priors. This imagined goal point clouds serve as additional inputs to the policy model, while an object–action consistency strategy with soft pose supervision explicitly aligns predicted end-effector motion with generated object transformation. This design enables Imagine2Act to reason about semantic and geometric relationships between objects and predict accurate actions across diverse tasks. Experiments in both simulation and real world demonstrate that Imagine2Act outperforms previous state-of-the-art policies. Code is fully open-sourced at https://github.com/LiangHeng121/Imagine2Act.
abstract_zh: 关系物体重排（ROR）任务（例如将花插入花瓶）要求机器人具备精确的语义和几何推理能力来操作物体。现有方法要么依赖难以捕捉复杂几何约束的预收集演示，要么生成目标状态观测以获取语义和几何知识，但未能将物体变换与动作预测显式耦合，导致生成噪声引发错误。为解决这些局限，我们提出Imagine2Act，一种3D模仿学习框架，将物体的语义和几何约束融入策略学习，以处理高精度操作任务。我们首先根据语言指令生成想象的目标图像，并重建对应的3D点云，以提供稳健的语义和几何先验。该想象目标点云作为策略模型的额外输入，同时一种带有软姿态监督的物体-动作一致性策略显式地将预测的末端执行器运动与生成的物体变换对齐。这一设计使Imagine2Act能够推理物体间的语义和几何关系，并在多样任务中预测准确动作。仿真和真实世界实验表明，Imagine2Act优于先前的最先进策略。代码已在https://github.com/LiangHeng121/Imagine2Act完全开源。
tldr_zh: Imagine2Act通过想象目标点云和物体-动作一致性策略提升机器人操作精度。
cover_zh: 机器人操作新思路｜用想象目标点云对齐动作，精度反超SOTA
